p.strong: Why a broker instead of pointing the container at the customer's IdP

div.p: One protocol to support — the container only ever speaks OIDC to your realm, whatever the customer runs behind it.
Entitlement is a group in their directory. Adding someone to /gis-team grants access; removing them revokes it. Nobody maintains a second list of users.
Swapping the upstream provider, adding a second one, or bolting on MFA changes the broker only. The container's configuration does not move.

text.tspan: You do not administer users here.
